title: Plug-and-Play blind super-resolution of real MRI images for improved multiple sclerosis diagnosis
summary: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is central to the diagnosis of multiple sclerosis, where the identification of biomarkers such as the central vein sign benefits from high-resolution images. However, most clinical brain MRI scans are performed using 1.5 T scanners, which provide lower sensitivity compared to higher-field systems. We propose a blind super-resolution framework to enhance real 1.5 T MRI images acquired in clinical settings, where only post-processed data are available and the degradation model is not fully known. The problem is formulated as a non-convex blind inverse problem…
